subject: Request: Private / VPC demo for regulated deployment
messages:
From: Sandra Hayes <sandra.hayes@medtechdx.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM PST
Subject: Private deployment inquiry — MedTech Diagnostics

Hi Marissa,

I signed up via your self-serve flow earlier and indicated interest in a private/VPC deployment. We are MedTech Diagnostics (HIPAA-adjacent) and need a demo focused on an on-prem or VPC deployment, data residency, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence.

Key questions up front:
- Do you support VPC peering + customer-managed KMS?
- Can we run an air-gapped on-prem package for isolated labs?
- How are audit logs surfaced for compliance reviews?

I'd like to get a 45–60 minute technical walkthrough with a solutions engineer and an outline of estimated timelines and costs. Our team is based in Boston (EST).

Are you available this week or early next?

Thanks,
Sandra Hayes
Head of IT Security
MedTech Diagnostics, Inc.
(sandra.hayes@medtechdx.com)

[Attachment: MedTech_RFI_2026-02.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Sandra — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up. I'm Marissa on the inbound SDR team and I’ll get a solutions engineer and infra engineer on the call to walk through VPC/on-prem options and compliance controls.

Quick things:
- We do support customer-managed KMS and VPC peering for the Private offering; we also have an on-prem air-gapped package for regulated workloads (we've done pilots with clinical lab customers).
- Monica (cc'd) is our lead SE for regulated deployments and will cover network topology and audit logs. Dev (cc'd) can speak to packaging/ops constraints if we need deeper infra detail.

Could you confirm your preferred timezone (you mentioned Boston/EST) and the best attendees on your side? Proposed times (all EST):
1) Thu Feb 19, 11:00–12:00 AM EST
2) Fri Feb 20, 09:00–10:00 AM EST
3) Mon Feb 23, 14:00–15:00 EST

I can also share a short pre-read (network checklist + SOC2 snapshot) ahead of the call — attaching our standard network requirements spreadsheet.

Calendly if you prefer to pick a time: https://calendly.com/marissa-co/private-vpc-demo

Best,
Marissa Cole
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply and for looping in Monica and Dev. EST works for us. Attendees: myself (security), Tom Alvarez (IT ops), and our procurement lead (Linda Park).

The Friday slot at 09:00–10:00 AM EST works best. Two additional asks for the session:
- Please include a quick demo of how audit logs are exported (format, retention, S3/Kafka options).
- We have some pre-filled RFI items in the attached PDF — it'd be great to walk any high-risk controls live.

Also note that procurement will request an estimated SLA and lead time for an air-gapped deployment; having order-of-magnitude timelines will help accelerate internal approvals.

If Friday is confirmed, please send a calendar invite with dial-in and the pre-read.

Regards,
Sandra
